name: ZFP 8 Relay PCB
subtitle: Full size; 15 cards mixed type can be connected on ABUS on the ZFP panel
legacyName: ZFP 8 Relay PCB (full size) (15 cards mixed type can be connected on ABUS on the ZFP panel)
family: Analogue Addressable ZFP Networkable Fire Panels
summary: The Z12 is an 8-Way Relay PCB designed to enhance the functionality of a Context Plus ZFP intelligent addressable fire panel to include 8 additional relay outputs.

specs.label: Indicators
specs.value: Polling LED; Power LED; Relay Activated (x8).

specs.label: Connections
specs.value: A-BUS RS485 connections (B, A, 0) to main ZFP PCB; 24V supply input (from main ZFP PCB or external EN54-4 PSU); Comms and Power In/Out connections. 8 x NO/C/NC relay connections.

specs.label: Product dimensions
specs.value: (mm) 80 W x 150 H x 30 D mm.

specs.label: Network specification Dedicated
specs.value: A-BUS RS485 monitored radial circuit. 1KM max length. Up to 15 A-BUS PCBs per panel.

specs.label: Notes
specs.value: Use Dipswitch SW1 to set the PCB's address - see main ZFP panel instructions for details.

features: Full size PCB can be scored in the middle to produce a half size 4way relay PCB.
Programmable via the ZFP’s PC Tools.
Polling, power and separate Relay Actibvated LED indicators.
Up to 15 A-BUS Expansion PCBs can be connected to a ZFP Panel via its RS485 A-BUS network.
Typically installed within the ZFP panel but can work up to 1 KM away for non-EN 54-2 functions.
